lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; triage 532/596. The reply folds into Part IV the tests the project refuses elsewhere (under a tenth: rental.under_tenth; real estate professional and grouping: sche.re_pro, sche.grouped) and the home tests (a home is not a passive rental: rental.ws51 refuses a home rented 15+ days; one rented under 15 days is left off Schedule E). The only completed difference, x1sche.f9.excluded_home (project true, reply false), is such an excluded home, which no Form 8582 line reads; all others are refused returns or partial records. i8582 p. 3: Part IV for 'rental real estate activities with active participation'.

Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage (596/596 agree): the reply sums rprop.cent over entries whose year is y2025, the project sums rprop.is_2025; both test that some property was placed in service in 2025 (i4562, Who Must File, 'Depreciation for property placed in service during the tax year').
